fusions.name: Taut-Cord Prowl
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then strikes, which deals 13 damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a loose brick at the first enemy it meets that deals 5 damage. Its damage rises 3% for each 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Quiet Footing
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 65% later, you move 17% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Bolt-Hole
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 30%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
